minutes_text:
MINUTES
  REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVTIES COMMISSION MEETING
  NOVEMBER 20, 2017

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was scheduled for 6:00 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes
  Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

  Due to a lack of quorum, with only CHAIR POPE and COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI present,
  CHAIR POPE adjourned the meeting at 7:25 p.m. to the regular Park & Activities Commission
  meeting of December 18, 2017 at 7:00 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Council Chamber, 4045
  Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  _________________________________  _________________________________
  Carol Corea  Heidi Luce
  Minutes Secretary  City Clerk
